## Change summary
Describe the behavior or contract change and why it is needed.

## Scope
- [ ] Catalogue / manifest / schema
- [ ] Product workspace
- [ ] Shared package
- [ ] CI / security / release
- [ ] Documentation

## Evidence
- [ ] CI passes on the exact proposed commit.
- [ ] Positive and negative tests cover new invariants.
- [ ] Catalogue, manifest, schema and docs are consistent.
- [ ] Rights and third-party notices have been reviewed.
- [ ] No secrets or customer data were introduced.
- [ ] Product maturity and release claims remain evidence-backed.
- [ ] High-impact / regulated functionality has the required specialist review.

## Release impact
State whether this changes product maturity, published artifact, dependency contract or migration requirements. If none, say none.
